descriptions.d28d_worm_armed_think_8013ae80: Armed worm thinking: stops a pending sound, returns when selected; plays the surrender clip when the owner's state asks for it. Keeps aiming while aiming is on. Acts on the squared distance to the selected worm: beyond 202500 a far clip; beyond 40000 aims at the camera position when within 70, else idles; below 6400 reacts to a faced, visible worm with a random clip or a ready clip, or aims or turns; otherwise aims when out of a 0.1 tolerance, or turns.
